title: VERDICT: the band squeeze window is EMPTY IN BODY (RHEnd part B10, discovery 0126) - t4l_bandWireBelow (wire + mass < devProg on the whole strip band, flank-independent, pure composition of t4m_margin [0118] + S2-in-body) and t4l_bandEmpty (no Qside can satisfy both squeeze legs at a band off-pair); t4l_stripFacesEmpty shows the B9 three-face bundle (G-hs1 + hs3-right + G-hs3-left) is jointly contradictory at every band off-pair - G-hs3-left and its right-flank twin dissolve as INDEPENDENT faces and the bundle collapses to one band-zero-exclusion face: rh_program78_stripfront_mach_vacant/_PT2 (+_ofB9/_PT2_ofB9, the B9 endpoint implies the vacant endpoint in body) - the unverified-region residual is now exactly two zero-exclusion faces (band, window) + [Z78] + the below-frontier record; the S1 pin family is the data side of the squeeze, certified by the squeeze certificate; B6 cross-check resolved (the packet scopes only Z78)

(B10.5) rh_program78_stripfront_mach_vacant_ofB9 (+ _PT2_ofB9) - the B9 endpoint (three strip faces + window + [Z78]) implies the vacant endpoint (band-exclusion + window + [Z78]) IN BODY via t4l_stripFacesEmpty: for the endpoint, the three-face bundle is EQUIVALENT to the single zero-exclusion face it encodes. The pre-check's S1-leg measurement is the measured margin of the B10.1 body inequality: devProg / (p8_B(t, n4) + MrLift(t, d0)) >= 1.1136 at the band edge d0 = 1/200 (sigma = 99/200), growing to ~1.1e4 by d0 = 1/2 (sigma = 0) - the body strictness is quantitative, not artifact. why_it_matters: This is the S9 unit promised by discovery 0125 - and it lands STRONGER and DIFFERENTLY than the numeric plan. The plan was to formalize 'devProg > wire on the left band, pending the B6 cross-check of the P1-P4 pins' as a numeric-flavored left-band statement. What the machine actually gives: the emptiness holds on the WHOLE strip band (1/200 <= d0 <= 1/2), BOTH flanks, IN BODY, as a two-line composition of two theorems that were already in the tree (t4m_margin, the S4 wire margin of discovery 0118, and FUnif.s2ActualFullBand, the S2 floor closure) - no new numerics, no left-flank specificity. The pre-check's >= 1.11 margin is confirmed as the measured size of a body inequality, not as the ingredient of one. The structural consequence is the real discovery: the four-face ledger of 0121/0122 (G-hs1 data, window record, machined hs3 right, G-hs3-left analytic) was not four independent faces - the three strip faces are jointly empty (t4l_stripFacesEmpty, in body), so the endpoint residual in the unverified region is exactly TWO zero-exclusion faces (band, window) on record footing, plus the external input [Z78] and the below-frontier record. G-hs3-left dissolves not by being closed as an analytic tail statement (that was S8: the true, useful, machine-verified left-model-point wall at the square-root schedule) but by being a component of the band-zero-exclusion face, which the squeeze certificate turns the S1 data side (the pin family) into. The left-flank analytic program (S7 schedule family, S8 wall) was necessary but never load-bearing for the endpoint: the load-bearing band content is the floor-over-wire inequality, in the body, flank-independent. Honest limits: (1) hNoStrip is an OPEN face - a zero-exclusion statement in the unverified region above the frontier, exactly on record footing with the window face; B10 changes the SHAPE of the residual (inequality faces to exclusion faces), not its open height. (2) The squeeze certificate shows pins + face are jointly contradictory at band off-pairs - it does not, by itself, measure zeta above the frontier. (3) No RH claim: the endpoint is conditional on hz78, the faces, and the record, as before. Next unit: the band-exclusion face hNoStrip is now the single analytic/data question of the strip band - candidate routes: (A) record extension (frontier push, external); (B) a measured/quoted zero-exclusion argument on the band (the data-squeeze pattern of 0106/0108 applies to hNoStrip exactly as it did to the window face: a face stated at/above the frontier with the record below); (C) the pins + certificate as a witness-level exclusion where data reach (at or below 3e12 the pins are measurable; a violation of any pin at a left-flank trial point would be a discovery, as in 0124 route B).
next: Unit S10 (the band-exclusion face): (1) formalize hNoStrip as the STRIP-BAND analog of the window face's record structure: check whether the Platt/Platt-Trudgian record (allOnLineUpTo, cited as [Z-PT2]) plus the strip geometry already gives hNoStrip below some height in the band, or whether hNoStrip is purely open above tPT2; (2) if purely open, apply the 0106/0108 squeeze pattern to it: is there a measured/quoted zero-exclusion that reaches part of the band region (analog of the window face's shrink)? (3) cross-check the S8 wall's residual use: t4l_wall_tuned now feeds T4OffL's record (the explicit left-model-point bound at the square-root schedule) - consider whether any face or consumer in the tree actually needs the model-point form (vs the pair-level exclusion form now certified by B10) - if none, record the S8 wall as the positive dual record of the G-hs3-left barriers (it already is, in the T4OffL card) and leave it as a machine fact; (4) then the two-face residual ledger (band + window exclusion + [Z78]) is the complete endpoint state to carry into future programs. No RH claim at any step.
